profile_text.body:
Peking University is a university based in Beijing, China, at No.5 Yiheyuan Road, Haidian District. Its site describes the university as offering access to a range of retail stores and services on campus, including bookstores, banking, and mail delivery services. The site is published in English and carries the university's copyright notice.

The university is recorded as a nonprofit institution and as a university lab. No AI products, MCP servers, or lawsuits involving the university are recorded.
